notes_for_editor: Three short records agree that an L-4 tower stood in the 1930s and is now abandoned and gone. The decade is the only build date in the sources, so no year-stamped event is listed. No staffing record was found. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page says it has no documented staffing and is not cited for that. A different Jungle Point (firelookout.com junglepoint.html: Nez Perce National Forest, 1930 camp, abandoned 1942, 5851 ft) is a separate site and must not be merged with this record. The record county 'Idaho' is the short form of Idaho County. No photos or present-day site evidence were found.
